title: Melf's First Staff
summary: A +1 quarterstaff that boosts spell attacks and spell save DC and casts Melf’s Acid Arrow.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 1 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 + 1 two-handed, plus Strength modifier. Simple, versatile, dippable, 5 ft melee. +1 to attack and damage, already in the damage notation.
fields.Arcane Enchantment: +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
fields.Melf’s Acid Arrow: Action, 60 ft, once per Long Rest. Cast as a level 2 spell. On a ranged spell attack hit, deal 4d4 Acid immediately and 2d4 Acid at the end of the target’s next turn. On a miss, deal half the initial damage and no delayed damage. The spell creates a 7 ft radius Acid surface that reduces AC by 2 while standing on it.
fields.Topple: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. On hit, a Dexterity save against weapon-action DC + 2 prevents Prone for 1 turn.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Blurg in Ebonlake Grotto, X 111, Y −89.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
